raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advance the MCore main pin and submodule from `e0c5e18673bf4d4fd89cf87c4f1afbe521fe297f` to `e30d863a6d82a3c45f2d71355dc73fbf5610967b`, and align Bridge's static Transformer Engine metadata and generated lock with the new upstream TE revision. `.dev.commit` is unchanged.

[Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/e0c5e18673bf4d4fd89cf87c4f1afbe521fe297f...e30d863a6d82a3c45f2d71355dc73fbf5610967b) includes request-local sampling seeds ([#7828](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/7828), optional with a `None` default) and the TE revision update ([#8036](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8036)).

Cause classification **2. No bug on either side, just incompatibility**: #8036 intentionally advances TE from `6ea2a74a` to `44f31bbe`; Bridge's static metadata must follow it to avoid assigning the old version to the new source. The metadata consistency check fails before the adaptation and passes afterward. No Bridge runtime code changes are included.

Validation: Linux/CUDA `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` pass (345 packages), TE source/version and upstream metadata agree, all-file pre-commit and `git diff --check` pass, main pin/gitlink match, and the dev pin and Bridge dependency overrides remain unchanged. Independent review found no blocking issues. The generated lock also normalizes markers inside packages already excluded by `sys_platform == 'never'` and their unreachable dependency subtree; these have no effective dependency change. Lock format remains unchanged.

Requested CI: **full L0/L1/L2**, preserving the midnight request and both tier labels. Current head `5f033e60fc947bb8c9d54813518964cccf029772` incorporates the landed base repairs [#6416](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6416) and [#6420](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6420). The original four-file bump diff and MCore pin remain unchanged.

[Current-head CICD NeMo run 38278795439, attempt 1](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/38278795439) **passed**: all four unit jobs and all 119 functional jobs, covering H100 L0/L1/L2 (30/26/17) and GB200 L0/L1/L2 (12/21/13). Configure outputs confirm `needs_more_tests=true`, `full_test_suite=true`, `expect_l1=true`, and `expect_l2=true`.

Standard gates are not yet all green: wheel/release is pending, and [link check attempt 2](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/38278790993) is running after a scoped retry. Attempt 1 reported only GitHub HTTP503 errors (37 occurrences); a representative failed URL now returns HTTP200. This is transient infrastructure, with no upstream MCore cause category.

The earlier GB200 config-lock permission failure came from base Bridge [#6162](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6162), independently reproduced on base main and fixed by #6420. The earlier historical documentation failure was repaired by #6416. Neither was caused by MCore; the upstream cause taxonomy does not apply to these unrelated base defects.

The TE metadata/lockfile changes require **current-head human approval** before merge. Functional full-suite success is verified; overall CI readiness remains pending the standard gates above.
